lines.trans: Are we dividing up the tips?
Seven thousand each today. Not much.
They gave me fifteen, and I have to take seven?
Why do I have to work for big-eared rookies?
What? Do I not work?

That is all. Goodbye.
Redhead, wait.

Easy! The winner will take the whole sum afterward.
